title: Power Outage Notification
shortDescription: The refrigerator detected a recent power outage.
fullDescription:
PO is an informational alert that the refrigerator lost power and regained it. It prompts the user to check food safety.

Press any button to clear the alert once you have inspected the contents.

fixSteps.title: Check food
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect refrigerator and freezer contents for safe temperatures.

fixSteps.title: Clear alert
fixSteps.instruction: Press any control button to dismiss.

videoSearchQuery: Maytag refrigerator PO power outage fix

faq.a: If the freezer stayed under 40F for less than 4 hours, most items are safe.

title: Refrigerator Sensor Error
shortDescription: Fresh food compartment thermistor has failed.
fullDescription:
E1 indicates the refrigerator section thermistor is returning invalid readings. Cooling may continue in emergency mode while the sensor is replaced.

Test the thermistor with a multimeter — resistance should be approximately 10k ohms at 32F.

fixSteps.title: Reseat harness
fixSteps.instruction: Locate and reconnect the thermistor plug.

whenToCallPro: If sensor is not accessible without major disassembly.

faq.a: Usually no — emergency cooling keeps temperatures reasonable.

title: Freezer Sensor Error
fullDescription:
E2 is similar to E1 but for the freezer section. The control loses accurate temperature feedback and runs in fallback mode.

Diagnose and replace the freezer thermistor.

fixSteps.title: Defrost
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug refrigerator for 24 hours to thaw ice.

whenToCallPro: If sensor is behind the evaporator cover.
videoSearchQuery: Maytag refrigerator E2 freezer sensor fix

title: Defrost Sensor Error
fullDescription:
E3 indicates the defrost thermistor or bimetal thermostat circuit has failed. The defrost cycle cannot complete, which leads to eventual freezer warming.

Replace the defrost sensor and test the defrost heater.
whenToCallPro: If full defrost system diagnosis is needed.
videoSearchQuery: Maytag refrigerator E3 defrost sensor fix

title: Ambient Temperature Sensor Error
fullDescription:
E4 means the ambient air thermistor (used for adaptive defrost and condenser fan speed) reports an invalid value. The refrigerator may run less efficiently but generally keeps cooling.

Replace the ambient sensor.

fixSteps.title: Test sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Verify sensor resistance vs. room temperature.

videoSearchQuery: Maytag refrigerator E4 ambient sensor fix

title: Condenser Fan Fault
shortDescription: Condenser fan has stopped or stalled.
fullDescription:
E5 indicates the condenser fan is not spinning as expected. Without condenser airflow, cooling efficiency drops and the compressor can overheat.

Check for debris, lubricate the motor, or replace the fan.
videoSearchQuery: Maytag refrigerator E5 condenser fan fix

faq.q: Do I need to clean coils often?

title: Communication Loss
shortDescription: Main control lost contact with user interface.
fullDescription:
E6 indicates the main control board cannot communicate with the dispenser/UI board. The display may go blank or flash.

Reseat the harnesses first; replace the UI or main board if needed.

fixSteps.title: Reseat harness
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect and reconnect UI ribbon cable.

whenToCallPro: If main board replacement is needed.
videoSearchQuery: Maytag refrigerator E6 UI error fix

title: Evaporator Fan Fault
shortDescription: The evaporator fan is not operating.
fullDescription:
EF indicates the evaporator fan motor is not reporting correct speed. Air cannot circulate over the evaporator coil into the compartments.

Remove the rear freezer panel, inspect for ice, and replace the fan if needed.
whenToCallPro: If ice re-forms quickly, investigate defrost system.
videoSearchQuery: Maytag refrigerator EF evaporator fan fix

faq.a: Defrost failures commonly cause EF indirectly.

title: Door Open Alert
shortDescription: A door has been left open too long.
fullDescription:
OP indicates a door (fridge or freezer) has been open for more than 5 minutes. An alarm sounds until it is closed.

Check the door switch if OP appears with the door closed.

fixSteps.title: Test door switch
fixSteps.instruction: Use multimeter to verify switch continuity.

videoSearchQuery: Maytag refrigerator OP door open alert

faq.a: After about 5 minutes of open door.

title: Demo Mode Active
shortDescription: Refrigerator is in showroom demo mode.
fullDescription:
dE means the refrigerator is operating in Demo Mode — the display works but cooling is disabled. This is often accidentally enabled by button combinations.

Exit Demo Mode by holding the door alarm and filter reset buttons for several seconds.

fixSteps.title: Exit demo
fixSteps.instruction: Hold the Door Alarm and Filter Reset buttons for 3-5 seconds.

faq.q: Was it set at the store?
faq.a: Possibly — many showroom units ship with demo on.

title: Refrigerator Fan Error
shortDescription: The refrigerator circulation fan has failed.
fullDescription:
Er rF indicates the refrigerator-compartment circulation fan (separate from evaporator fan on multi-fan models) is not turning.

Check for obstructions, test the motor, or replace it.

fixSteps.title: Inspect fan
fixSteps.instruction: Remove rear wall of fridge and test blade.

whenToCallPro: If the damper control is also involved.
videoSearchQuery: Maytag refrigerator Er rF fan fix

faq.a: Multi-fan models have a dedicated fresh food fan.

title: Communication Fault
fullDescription:
Er CF indicates a serial-bus communication failure between the main control board and a peripheral (inverter, dispenser, or UI). Cooling may continue on fallback defaults.

Reseat harnesses; if unresolved, replace the offending board.

fixSteps.title: Reseat harnesses
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect and reseat all control harnesses.

videoSearchQuery: Maytag refrigerator Er CF communication fault
